EGY.note: Huawei Cloud region is a commercial cloud; no AI computing named.

facts.fact: ICT minister Amr Talaat said Egypt launched its cloud-first policy through the Supreme Council for Digital Society, and that a top-level government committee hosted by MCIT has been formed to prepare a plan for state bodies, authorities and ministries to benefit from the policy.

EGY.note: Local-cloud plan for startups is not a startup law, strategy or fund.
